subject: Post-demo: token economics & per-model volume breakdown
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@axonmed.ai>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@axonmed.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: token economics & per-model volume breakdown

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and thanks for the product walkthrough. Quick recap and a few asks so we can size the right configuration and give you target pricing for a pilot + production run. Attaching a short token summary (axon_token_summary.xlsx).

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Primary flow: clinician note generation + patient summary (chat/generation) for 60–70% of traffic.
- Vector search / embeddings for similarity lookups in the knowledge base ~20–30%.
- Reranking endpoint for results pipeline ~5–10%.
- Expected growth: pilot -> production within 90 days, steady-state after 6 months.

Asks / info we need to finalize pricing: 
1) Expected monthly token volume (approx). If you prefer daily that's fine — we just want month-over-month.
2) Desired per-model split (chat / embeddings / rerank) in % so we can show blended unit economics and per-model $/1M tokens targets.
3) Target budget range (monthly) or target $/1M tokens you have in mind.
4) Procurement timeline (PO, MSA, SOC2 evidence required).

Initial next steps from our side: Ben and Lauren will prepare a two-option commercial outline (Hosted vs Dedicated optimized) with per-model $/1M token estimates and a blended cost for your stated split. Dev — we'll loop you on the RTT and quantization notes if the customer wants a Dedicated option.

Attachments: axon_token_summary.xlsx (high-level call notes + token estimation template)

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Reddy <priya@axonmed.ai>

Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@axonmed.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token economics & per-model volume breakdown

Thanks, Ben — good recap. A few clarifications / numbers from our side: 

1) Expected volume: for pilot (months 1–3) ~300M tokens/month. Production steady-state (months 4+) ~1.1B tokens/month. We expect a ramp, so please show pricing for both pilot and steady-state.

2) Model split (approx, steady-state):
- Chat / generation: 60%
- Embeddings (vector search): 30%
- Rerank: 10%

3) Budget: rough procurement target is $2k–$6k/month for pilot; production budget TBD but we expect to get to $15k–$30k/month depending on performance/cost. For evaluation, our target unit economics is somewhere between $5–$12 per 1M tokens (we know this is broad — happy to see your breakdown).

4) Procurement: legal review on our side will take ~3 weeks after you send the MSA. SOC2 evidence required; security questionnaire attached on our end (we'll send separately).

Please include both a conservative estimate (hosted, no quantization) and an optimized projection (dedicated + quantization/batching) so we can see the delta. Also include expected latency SLOs for each option.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Platform
Axon Medical
priya@axonmed.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@axonmed.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@axonmed.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token economics & per-model volume breakdown

Priya — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. Below is a concise two-option pricing sketch (pilot = 300M/mo; steady-state = 1.1B/mo) using your 60/30/10 split. We'll follow up with a PDF with the math and a recommended Dedicated configuration.

Assumptions: average request = 1.5k tokens for chat prompts+generation; embeddings call = 1k tokens per vector op; rerank = 500 tokens per call. These are placeholders — if you have different averages we'll update.

Option A — Hosted (conservative):
- Per-model list price estimates (hosted):
  - Chat (Llama-2-class model): $14 per 1M tokens
  - Embeddings (open-vector): $2.50 per 1M tokens
  - Rerank (reranker model): $9 per 1M tokens

Blended /1M token = (0.60*$14) + (0.30*$2.5) + (0.10*$9) = $8.9 per 1M tokens

Pilot monthly cost (300M tokens, same split): 300 * $8.9 = $2,670/month (estimate)
Steady-state monthly cost (1.1B tokens): 1100 * $8.9 = $9,790/month (estimate)

Option B — Dedicated + optimization (batching, prefix caching, int8 quantization):
- Modeled unit prices (after optimizations):
  - Chat: $9 per 1M tokens
  - Embeddings: $1.2 per 1M tokens
  - Rerank: $5 per 1M tokens

Blended /1M token = (0.60*$9) + (0.30*$1.2) + (0.10*$5) = $6.14 per 1M tokens

Pilot monthly cost (300M): 300 * $6.14 = $1,842/month
Steady-state (1.1B): 1100 * $6.14 = $6,754/month

Notes and caveats:
- These are ballpark estimates for commercial discussion. Actuals will depend on exact model selection, sequence-length distribution, and whether you accept model variants compatible with quantization.
- Dedicated option requires a 3–4 week bootstrap (capacity provisioning + canary).
- We can potentially push the blended to sub-$5/1M with heavier batching and a higher proportion of quantized model variants, but that trades off some generation quality/latency.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm (a) average prompt+response token counts and (b) your tolerance for quantized model variants.
2) We'll produce a formal two-option commercial (pdf) + MSA draft for legal review.
3) If numbers look good, we can provision a 30-day pilot account (pilot credit + usage dashboard) and run initial evaluation traffic.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_v1.pdf (pricing sketch + math)
